label: Protectli Vault Pro VP2420
description: Fanless Intel Celeron J6412 appliance with four Intel 2.5GbE RJ45 ports (i225-V or i226-V depending on build date) and no wireless; the classic quad-2.5G pfSense/OPNsense box.
notes: 4x 2.5G, no fans, no Wi-Fi - great WAN/LAN/DMZ/OPT lab corner. Existing catalogue copy of VP2420 is categorised 'firewall'; this batch uses 'host' for all SBC/mini-PC/fanless-appliance entries.
